title: Brain Fog, Part 1 - Is Your Brain in a Fog?
summary: Dr. David Musnick (Dr. M), board-certified in Internal Medicine and Sports Medicine with 35+ years in regenerative and functional medicine, dives straight into one of the most common complaints he sees: brain fog.

title: Brain Fog, Part 2 - Testing and Basic Solutions
summary: Dr. David Musnick (Dr. M) picks up where Part 1 left off and gets specific about which tests make sense for brain fog and which basics help almost everyone.

title: Insomnia - Causes and Practical Sleep Strategies
summary: Dr. M breaks down insomnia and sleep: difficulty falling or staying asleep, types of insomnia, and why 7+ hours of quality sleep matters for reducing inflammation in your brain and body—plus practical tools for wind-down, caffeine timing, natural supports, and more.

title: Electromagnetic Frequencies (EMF) - Practical Ways to Reduce Exposure
summary: Dr. Musnick explains how RF, EMF, and electrical fields affect the brain and blood-brain barrier—and practical steps to reduce exposure from phones, WiFi, Bluetooth, vehicles, and smart meters.

title: Energy - Understanding Fatigue and Mitochondrial Health
summary: Dr. M takes a functional-medicine look at energy, fatigue, and mitochondrial health, including sleep, inflammation, viral reactivation, infections, mold, heavy metals, hormones, organ stress, and practical supports for ATP production.

title: Concussion - What Happens in the Brain
summary: Dr. Musnick explains concussion and traumatic brain injury mechanisms, from neural shearing, excitotoxicity, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, hypoxia, and blood-brain barrier disruption to persistent symptoms and recovery pathways.

title: The Brain on Fire - Neuroinflammation After Concussion
summary: Dr. Musnick explains brain reserve and why symptom relief may precede full recovery, then explores glial cells, M1 and M2 microglia, neuroinflammation after concussion, and research-informed recovery factors.

title: Food and the Brain - Eating for Brain Health and Concussion Recovery
summary: Dr. Musnick explains how he approaches eating for brain sharpness and concussion recovery, covering apigenin, choline, omega-3s, Nrf2-supportive foods, turmeric, quercetin, rosemary, protein, blood sugar, the microbiome, and selected elimination strategies.
